in_hebrew.name: Greenwald
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Greenwald הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. A surname of Germanic origin, derived from the Old English words 'grun' meaning 'green' and 'wald' meaning 'forest'. This name was likely given to someone who lived near a forest or had a strong connection to nature.
